class.name: PXTGIEmissionMeter
class.experimental: Part of PXTGI3D, which may still change.
class.brief_description: Measures how brightly materials glow and what share of light they reflect, for [PXTGI3D]'s [code]pxtgi_emission[/code] and [code]pxtgi_albedo[/code] tags.

method.name: albedo_tag
method.description: The [code]pxtgi_albedo[/code] [Color] that stands for a measured (linear) [param albedo]: sRGB encoded, as [PXTGI3D] reads it.

method.name: emission_tag
method.description: The [code]pxtgi_emission[/code] [Color] that stands for a measured (linear) [param glow]: sRGB encoded, as [PXTGI3D] reads it.

method.name: find_untagged
method.description: The [ShaderMaterial]s used under [param root] (itself included) that [PXTGI3D] can't read a glow from: with no [code]pxtgi_emission[/code] on the material or on the [MeshInstance3D] using it. Each maps to an [Array] of the [MeshInstance3D]s using it.

method.name: find_untagged_albedo
method.description: The materials used under [param root] (itself included) whose albedo [PXTGI3D] can't read in full and that have no [code]pxtgi_albedo[/code]: [ShaderMaterial]s, and [BaseMaterial3D]s with an albedo texture (PXTGI reads their color, not the texture's). Each maps to an [Array] of the [MeshInstance3D]s using it.

method.name: is_measuring
method.description: Whether a [method measure] is still running.

method.name: measure
method.description: Starts measuring [param materials] (any kind of [Material]); [signal finished] gives the results. Needs a running [SceneTree], with a window: it draws. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] while a measuring is running.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: The measurements, one [Dictionary] for each material in the order given: [code]material[/code], [code]glow[/code] (a linear [Color]), [code]luminance[/code] (its brightness), [code]changes[/code] (whether it changed while being read) and [code]albedo[/code] (a linear [Color], each channel 0-1).
